predictions: Ok, not too bad last week. 18-7 gives me two decent weeks in a row. And I would be doing waaaaay better if C division would just go away. I'm down to a preposterous 5-10 at this point, which is my only division that isn't a winning record (and man is that not a winning record). Add in the fact that I lost yet another 1001 pick result last week, it's a minor miracle that I'm up to 81-43 (65.3% correct) for the season. Crossing my fingers that a giant sinkhole takes those C matches away, man…

Match of the week: (D Div.) Rif Raf @ Wing & A Plaque. Oh, here we go!! One of the last two possible all-undefeated battles of the season! These two have picked off all comers so far, and they have a two-match lead on anyone else. But it hasn't all come easy… fully half of these teams' ten total wins have been by 13-11 or 12-12 scores. I was on the Wing train before the season, and I'm still there. 13-11. Again.

Match #2: (B Div.) Hump Day! @ Darty Minds. B division has real minefield potential pretty much every week, and that's why Hump Day didn't carry this match into undefeated land. But despite those weekly mines waiting for any good team, Darty Minds has yet to have an opponent within even a game of a tie. The Darty roll continues, 15-9.

Match #3: (G Div.) I Got Your 6 @ Dart Knights. G division has fashioned itself into the best overall race of the league through five weeks. Five teams separated by 1 match and 14 points, and one or two big matches every week. This week offers us the top two point teams in that race, so this is huge. Interestingly, this is a matchup of SCkt dominance vs. DCkt dominance. I'll take the Knights, 13-11.

Match #4: (A Div.) Talladega Flights @ Brave the Elements. The biggest hurdle to an undefeated A showdown is this pairing of long- time top-of-A rivals. Talladega has had a couple hiccups, but they can beat anyone, and Element better bring all they got. Element, 14-10.

Match #5: (G Div.) Heart of Dartness @ The Dartifacts. For best explanation, see match #3 above… This other big matchup brings us the only other 4-1 team (Dartness) taking on the second of the 3-2 teams (Dartifacts). The Dartifacts, with a couple of the division's best throwers, are the tougher team to figure out. So I'll go Dartness, 13-11.

Match #6: (E Div.) Death Throw @ Dirty Darts Done Dirt Cheap. On the one side, this is the top two teams in E after five weeks. But on the other side, maybe this is just Dirty's chance to push the first of the four chase teams a third match back already. Dirty it is, 15-9.

Match #7: (D Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ Menace 2 Sobriety. Wing and Rif Raf feel like they're a long way ahead of the pack in D. And that's mostly because they are… But if any other team is going to make a run at them, it's the winner of this pairing. Rangers, in 1001.

Match #8: (C Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ The Outlaws. The Outlaws got a little thumped in their last match, for their first loss. Constantly thumped a team in their last match, for their first win. The interesting part of that? The opponent in both those outcomes was the same team(?!). Outlaws return things to normalcy, 14-10.

Match #9: (F Div.) That's What She Said @ Sofa Kings. Sofa sits just outside the trio of 4-1 teams. She Said sits IN that trio though, on the strength of three 13-11 wins in a row. She Said, 13-11. Duh.

Match #10: (D Div.) Dart Side of the Moon @ Irish Ton. Two of the five 2-3 and 1-4 teams are likely to be in E next season. A match between 1-4s feels pretty key in that race, no? Dart Side, 13-11-ish.
Match #11: (E Div.) Bangin The Wire @ Runs with Corks. Death Throw has to face Dirty tonight, meaning the winner here is likely immediately racing Rippin for the #2 slot. Full lineup Corks? 13-11.

Match #12: (G Div.) Bright side of Flights @ Triple Shot. Is this a battle to avoid the league's cellar? Or is this just the creation of Bright side's first win streak ever? Let's go win streak! Bright, 13-11.
And the remaining 13 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Lunatic Fringe 17, Serious? 7; Show Me 15, Stumble 9.
B Division: Inconsistent 14, McGavin 10; In The Hall 14, Sam's 10.

D Division: Liquor Possee 13, Ton 80 Proof 11.
E Division: Machine 16, She-nanigans 8; Rippin 14, Cheapies 10.
